items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: We didn't have but two horns then. They had Hulk and Ernest Highlands, because Teddy hadn't got there. He had Teddy Riley.

ctx.x: Yeah. I want a Little Girl to Love A Lot. Yeah. He said, man, see Danny bent on me, but he didn't, from the neighborhood, but he didn't know that I had the knowledge about music that I did, you know. He told me, he said, man I heard you can arrange. I said, yeah, he said, can you write this, the background for this? I said, yeah, I can write it. I said, but you got to bring me a record player, because I ain't got any player on where I live at. I ain't no record player. So he brought his record player over and he…
He'd come to my place I lived by myself.
